confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Sri Lankan cultural-triangle towns, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant food prices are the most reliable. Beer and wine are less certain because Sri Lanka's alcohol taxes and limited bar supply vary by venue, and draught beer is rarely served, so beer is anchored to a 0.5 L bottle equivalent. Cocktail is set from the beer relationship (about 1.8x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. Accommodation is the least certain, since July demand around Dambulla and Sigiriya varies with the season and events. FX: the 0.6955 USD per AUD observation (15 Oct 2026, 4.00 pm) was taken from search-result summary text for the RBA exchange-rates overview page. I did not read the rate directly from rba.gov.au, so verify it against the F11.1 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the Sri Lankan Cultural Triangle towns (Sigiriya, Habarana, Anuradhapura, Kandy outskirts) and the general Sri Lankan tourist-town price level, adjusted for Dambulla's small size, limited bar supply, and high share of guesthouse accommodation.
